description:
This video explains New York City's climate history and outlook, covering temperature, precipitation, sea-level rise, and extreme weather events. It discusses the urban heat island effect, heat-related deaths, and the impact of climate change on the city's infrastructure and residents. The video also explores the complexities of climate change, including the shifting probability distribution of weather events and the importance of adaptive planning.

Report sources:
https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/products/land-based-station/us-climate-normals
https://climateassessment.nyc/assessment/nyc-climate-risk-information-2022-observations-and-projections/
